title: lazycron belongs on your radar
description:
mc7h/lazycron is the kind of repo that can quietly upgrade a developer workflow. A terminal UI for managing cron jobs, systemd timers, and launchd agents. Inspired by lazygit and lazydocker. It has about 3 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/mc7h/lazycron
